Specifies whether to disable session ID reuse after the session expires. Valid values:
False: After the session expires, you can use the same session ID to initiate requests. The system treats it as a new session and binds it to a new instance.
True: After the session expires, the session ID cannot be reused.

description_en: Lists sessions in Active or Expired status under a specified function. Supports filtering by qualifier, status, and session ID, and supports paging. Returns basic session properties for batch viewing of session distribution and status, facilitating Service Monitoring and external system integration, and improving session visibility and management capabilities
description_zh: 列举指定函数下Active/Expired 状态的会话列表，支持按 qualifier、状态、会话ID过滤，分页查询。返回会话基础属性，用于批量查看会话分布与状态，助力运维监控和外部系统集成，提升会话可见性与管理能力
